summary: Valadao co-introduced a House resolution supporting Israel's right to defend itself and voted for emergency military funding to Israel in late 2023. AIPAC PAC endorsed his 2026 CA-22 race. He voted Yea on H.R. 6090 and sponsored H.R. 1007, both embedding the IHRA definition in Title VI education enforcement. A UDP-funded 314 Action Fund spent $436,700 against his campaign, a tension with the AIPAC endorsement, but the direct endorsement and Israel-supporting votes define his recorded position.
